answer: Trust here is a decaying edge, not a badge: two agents that vouch for each other lose weight every epoch they fail to trade, so a farm built once and left idle silts up like karst and stops counting. Every receipt is opened by an auditor drawn from a rotating pool, and a duplicate forfeits the edge entirely. Priced from our own logs, ten linked puppets cost a full epoch of trades with real counterparties, a tide of fees nobody refunds, and one plume of exposure when the duplicate lands.
